newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's employers, unions ready for draft accord.
newsitem.headline: Spain's employers, unions ready for draft accord.

text.p: Spain's employers and unions said on Wednesday they were ready to draft an accord on labour reforms after reaching a broad agreement.

"Today we have come close enough in our positions to give us sufficient basis to become more concrete and put things down on paper," Antonio Gutierrez, head of the Workers' Commissions (CCOO) union told a news conference.
Employers association (CEOE) head Jose Maria Cuevas said employer and union representatives would start to draft a document this afternoon that would provide the basis for a final accord.
The two sides would not expand on the likely contents of a final deal.
Unions presented a new proposal on Wednesday which bent to employer demands for lower severance pay, in exchange for a more permanent contract.
The government said earlier on Wednesday it wanted an accord struck by the end of the week.
